title: Prisma Grinlok
extract:
The Prisma Grinlok is the Prisma variant of the  Grinlok semi-automatic rifle featuring higher critical chance, critical multiplier, status chance, magazine, and different damage distribution, but lower accuracy with sustained fire.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Can equip the Grinlok-exclusive  Deadly Sequence and  Grinloked (Conclave only) mods.
Innate  polarity.
Advantages over other Primary Semi-Auto Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Grinlok for the second highest base damage of all semi-automatic rifles, behind  Kuva Chakkhurr.
Second highest critical multiplier of all semi-automatic rifles, behind  Tiberon Prime.
Second highest status chance of all semi-automatic rifles, behind  Nagantaka.
Little to no vertical recoil.
Very small spread.
Excellent ammo efficiency.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Above average sustained DPS (384.86)
High magazine size (21)
Above average damage per shot (261.61)
Above average total damage (187)
Very high ammo pickup (80)
High reload speed (1.70 s)
High ammo max (540)
Very high status chance (37.00%)
High crit multiplier (2.90x)
Disadvantages over other Primary Semi-Auto Rifle weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Tied with  Grinlok for the second slowest fire rate of all semi-automatic rifles, after  Kuva Chakkhurr.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Low crit chance (21.00%)
Below average burst DPS (436.89)
Below average accuracy (0.25° to 6.00°)
Below average fire rate (1.67 attacks/sec)
Below average disposition (●●●●○ (1.25x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Prisma Grinlok (Normal Attack), compared to  Grinlok (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Lower  Impact damage ( 74.8 vs.  93.5)
Higher  Slash damage ( 93.5 vs.  74.8)
Higher base critical chance (21.00% vs. 15.00%)
Higher base critical multiplier (2.90x vs. 2.50x)
Higher base status chance (37.00% vs. 35.00%)
Higher average damage per tap (261.61 vs. 229.07)
Higher burst DPS (436.89 vs. 382.55)
Higher sustained DPS (384.86 vs. 290.81)
Larger magazine (21 vs. 9)
Less accurate (32 vs. 44.4)
Tighter first-shot spread (0.25° vs. 1.50°)
Wider maximum spread (6.00° vs. 3.00°)
Higher Mastery Rank required (11 vs. 7)
Lower disposition (●●●●○ (1.25x) vs. ●●●●○ (1.30x))

Acquisition
The Prisma Grinlok is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for  220,000 and ‍ 500. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
The weapon can be traded, but only for unranked copies without Forma and Orokin Catalyst installed. The trading recipient must also have a Mastery Rank of at least 11.
